summary: An engraver's bench drawn all the way through, with a generator that reads the player's record and a ladder that climbs to 270 — it passes on the stills and the code, with the pull's filmstrip blank and owed a re-shoot.
fixes: Re-shoot moment-pull: all twelve frames are white; set the burst's interval to 0.25 s and delay 1.6 s in qa.json and confirm -demo pull renders
Move the margin scars off the plate caps: PlateView.swift:607-618 draws the hairline through 'OF 12 POINTS' so it reads as a strikethrough
Lift the win's primary action out from under the tab bar: PullView bottom padding 62 hides 'Rule the next plate' at first view
Give the run's shelf real prints: plates 47–50 are four identical hatched rectangles; peg the record's compact PrintSheet behind each and drop the Rack image from the locked block
Redraw plate.svg's hatching at +40°/+72°: the onboarding hero crosses at a right angle and reads as a window screen, the draft DESIGN.md rejects
Let the daily seal: Generator.swift:107 takes two off the shape so Sunday's rung 205 seals nothing, against DESIGN.md's 'two clues sealed'
Make the depth dial describe the plate: measured depth is 5 at rung 5 and 6 at rung 51 against targets 2 and 4, so the dial is inert until about rung 66
